name: Exp_KWAN_NRP
summary: This EA trades based on the KWAN (Kase Wealth Accumulation Network) No-Repaint indicator, which is a momentum-based signal generator. It enters long positions when the KWAN indicator signals bullish momentum and enters short positions when it signals bearish momentum. The EA systematically executes trades without discretionary input, relying solely on the non-repainting KWAN signals for entry and exit decisions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于KWAN（Kase财富积累网络）无重绘指标进行交易，该指标是一种基于动量的信号生成器。当KWAN指标发出看涨动量信号时做多，发出看跌动量信号时做空。EA系统化地执行交易，完全依赖无重绘KWAN信号进行入场和出场决策。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用KWAN动量指标作为核心策略引擎，KWAN指标结合了价格动量和波动率分析来识别趋势方向和强度。入场条件为KWAN指标发出方向性信号——当指标从负转正或突破零轴时做多，从正转负或跌破零轴时做空。出场条件通常依赖反向KWAN信号或固定的止损止盈水平，部分版本可能加入跟踪止损机制。仓位管理方面，EA可能支持固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位计算。资金管理方面，由于KWAN是动量型指标，在趋势明确时表现较好，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损，缺乏明确的市场状态过滤器是一个潜在风险点。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the KWAN momentum indicator as its core strategy engine, which combines price momentum and volatility analysis to identify trend direction and strength. Entry conditions are triggered by directional KWAN signals — going long when the indicator turns positive or crosses above zero, and going short when it turns negative or crosses below zero. Exit conditions typically rely on reverse KWAN signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, with some versions potentially incorporating a trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing may support fixed lot sizes or account-balance-proportional calculation methods. Money management is a concern since the KWAN indicator, being momentum-based, performs well in clear trending markets but may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses, and the lack of an explicit market state filter is a potential risk point.

parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

pros: KWAN指标无重绘特性确保信号可靠性，入场后不会因后续价格变化而消失
动量策略在强趋势市场中表现优异，能捕捉较长的趋势波段
系统化交易消除情绪干扰，严格执行信号规则
pros_en: The no-repaint property of the KWAN indicator ensures signal reliability — signals don't disappear after entry due to subsequent price changes
Momentum strategies perform excellently in strong trending markets, capturing extended trend waves
Systematic trading eliminates emotional interference, strictly executing signal rules
cons: 纯动量策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁虚假信号，导致连续小额亏损
缺少市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率过滤器），无法区分趋势市和震荡市
默认止损为零意味着如果用户不手动设置，将面临无限风险暴露
cons_en: Pure momentum strategies tend to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive small losses
Lacks a market state filter (such as ADX or volatility filter) to distinguish trending from ranging conditions
Default stop-loss of zero means unlimited risk exposure if the user doesn't manually configure it
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX>25或ATR阈值），仅在趋势明确时开仓，减少震荡市中的虚假信号
实现动态止损止盈机制，基于ATR或KWAN指标值自动调整，而非依赖固定点数
improvements_en: Add a market state filter (e.g., ADX>25 or ATR threshold) to only open positions when a trend is confirmed, reducing false signals in ranging markets
Implement dynamic stop-loss and take-profit based on ATR or KWAN indicator values instead of relying on fixed pip values

risk_points: 默认止损为零，用户未设置止损时面临无限下行风险
缺少震荡市过滤机制，在横盘市场中可能连续亏损
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss is zero, exposing users to unlimited downside risk when not manually configured
No ranging market filter, potentially causing consecutive losses in sideways markets

It enters long positions when the KWAN indicator signals bullish momentum and enters short positions when it signals bearish momentum. The EA systematically executes trades without discretionary input, relying solely on the non-repainting KWAN signals for entry and exit decisions.
